say:1:1421612001:1.text: Mina, let me take a good look at you! Thank the stars, no injuries, no marks...
say:1:1421612001:1.source_cn: 米娜，让我看看你！没有受伤，也没有被施加印记！

say:2:1421612002:1.text: Oh, I'm so glad you're safe! I've been worried sick!
say:2:1421612002:1.source_cn: 你没事真是太好了！我一直在担心你！

say:3:1421612003:1.text: I ran into some real danger out in the wilds. Ewan and Magister Merlin found me just in time...
say:3:1421612003:1.source_cn: 我在野外遇到了危险，幸好埃文和这位梅林大人及时找到了我……
say:3:1421612003:1.male: I ran into some real danger out in the wilds. Ewan and Magister Merlin found me just in time...
say:3:1421612003:1.female: I ran into some real danger out in the wilds. Ewan and Magister Merlin found me just in time...

say:4:1421612004:1.text: Enough about me. Delina, listen, do you have any spare coconut oil by any chance? Ewan desperately needs some, and the market stalls are all closed by now.
say:4:1421612004:1.source_cn: 不说这些了，德琳，你这里有没有多余的香椰油？埃文有急用...

say:5:1421612005:1.text: I only have a tiny bit left... But still, never mind that, take it! Helping Ewan out of this tight spot is what matters most!
say:5:1421612005:1.source_cn: 有是有，但只剩下最后一点了……没事，你拿走吧！先帮埃文...

say:6:1421612006:1.text: But Delina... what if your master finds out?

say:7:1421612007:1.text: If I'm found out, I'll come running to you for help. You won't just leave me behind will you?
say:7:1421612007:1.source_cn: 如果被发现，我再来找你们帮忙嘛！等那个时候，你可不要不管我！

say:8:1421612008:1.text: Right then! I'll go meet Ewan at the market. I know he'll want to thank you in person once this is all resolved!
say:8:1421612008:1.source_cn: 我明白了，我先去市集找埃文，事情解决后他一定会亲自来感...
